headerDisplay: Exposes pollen levels from the [Ambee API](https://www.getambee.com/) as HomeKit air quality sensors.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Ambee API key. Get one at https://api-dashboard.getambee.com/

location.title: Location
location.description: Zip code or place name to fetch pollen data for.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch pollen data from Ambee. Minimum 15 minutes. Free tier allows ~100 calls/day.

enableCategorySensors.title: Enable Per-Category Sensors
enableCategorySensors.description: Add 3 additional air quality sensors for Tree, Grass, and Weed pollen.
